title: MaxMessageTermination should by default only count ChatMessage
body:
Because AgentEvent are not conversation between agents. 

Events like `UserInputRequestedEvent` and function call related events should not be counted by default, as they are not intuitive to consider as part of the count for termination.

linked_prs.title: fix: do not count agent event in MaxMessageTermination condition

ai_judgment.response:
**Yes**  
This is an agent issue as it relates to memory content errors, specifically the incorrect handling of message attributes and events in the agent's workflow, which affects the behavior of the LLM-based agent system.
